title: AI is for everyone, at every age
tip: You do not need to know technology to begin. Ask one simple question, try a small everyday task, and learn at your own pace. Check important answers.
cta: What would you like to learn with AI? Tell us in the comments and follow @everydayaifinds99.

title: Recruiting: compare job requirements
tip: Paste a job description and ask AI to build a skills checklist. Remove candidate names and review decisions yourself.
